description: Measure Would Allow Eligible Teachers to Purchase Full-Time Service Credit for Years Spent Working Part Time to Raise Children State Senator Nick Collins announced that the Massachusetts Senate adopted an amendment to the economic development bill that would provide greater retirement equity for teachers who reduced their hours to raise children. The amendment was sponsored
paid_for_by: sponsored by Senator John Velis and cosponsored by Collins and a bipartisan group of senators
title: Senator Collins Supports Retirement Benefits for Teachers - Senator Nick Collins
